book: Agrawal ExamCart, SSB OIR, Reasoning section
scans: SSR OIR 1-127 (phone photos of printed pages 1-127)
title: Paper Cutting and Folding
note: Drawn questions (D29). Each keyed question is read into sheet units (the sheet 12 across, y down): the folds in the order made, with a point on the side that stays; the punches or cuts on the folded sheet; and each answer figure's marks. `fold` is what the solver reads and the drawings are made from it. A mark is a kind (round hole, triangle and the way it points, square, cut-out by its corners) at a place. Stems and options describe the drawings in words; the book prints figures only. The punch marks are read from the photos and placed where the folded sheet puts them; where a panel is drawn loosely the question says so. Q19 runs the other way: the opened sheet is shown and the options are folded sheets.

directions.text: A piece of paper is folded and Punched as shown in question figures from the given answer figures Indicate it will appear when opened.
